scope: Article/static-site validation only; no agent-engine benchmark
review_method: Sequential evidence, structure and reader-walkthrough self-review by one assistant; not independent reviewer consensus

browser.tool: Playwright with a fresh Chromium headless context and temporary loopback static server
browser.diagram_text_containment: Both locales passed, including final shortened group label
browser.network_policy: Article tests blocked external requests; Google Fonts CSS replaced with empty CSS; no user model settings/credentials loaded. Local servers used ephemeral ports and were closed.

zh.visual_review: All pages reviewed in contact sheets; representative pages at full size
zh.acceptance: not passed: Chinese glyphs missing in local LibreOffice PDF/PNG; exported PPTX XML retains Chinese text

en.visual_review: All pages reviewed in contact sheets; representative pages at full size
en.acceptance: English text visible; fallback fonts differ from browser typography, so pixel parity is not claimed

publication.note: Narration is a pre-release artifact; no AI narration generation during editing.

limitations: PPTX/LibreOffice Chinese rendering is not accepted; no shared exporter or global font changes were made.
Sparse export pages are advisory density findings, not agent-performance results.
Browser assertions cover the tested viewports; they are not an accessibility or cross-browser certification.
No source file changes or migrations were made to DirectorStudio production code.
